messages:
maria_cs: Weekly health check for ZenChart — model-mix shift after v2 rollout. Quick snapshot request: usage trends, latency spikes, fallback rates, cost impact. @oliver_pm can you share adoption notes? cc @nora_sre for the latency alerts.

jacob_se: Canary started Tue — ~48% of generative calls hitting `zen-v2`, rest to `zen-baseline`. Observed ~6% fallback to baseline. Unsure if timeouts or compatibility fallback.

nora_sre: Noted a p50 jump 110ms -> 160ms during Wed peak (14:00 UTC). p95 went up to ~420ms for v2. Error rate (4xx/5xx) stayed ~flat. Traces attached in separate thread.

maria_cs: Breakout on fallback reasons: ~3.5% kv-cache misses (cold), ~2.5% runtime OOM fallbacks. OOM fallbacks are the risky part for renewals. Need mitigation suggestions.

oliver_pm: Customer metrics look encouraging — convo completion rate +9% on v2. They asked about lowering unit cost. Recommending a quantized variant might help.

jacob_se: Plan: shift 20% traffic to `zen-v2-quant` and enable prefix caching. I'll open RB to change routing policy and run smoke.

nora_sre: Logs snippet for OOMs:
```
fallback_reason=OOM model=zen-v2 request_id=abcd-1234 instance=gpu-7
```
Mitigations: reduce batch_size for v2 and pre-warm small-kv caches. Adding trace spans to pinpoint cold starts.

maria_cs: Spend note: last 7d cost +18% vs prior period, driven by longer average token lengths and cache misses. I'll surface this in renewal notes and propose Redwood Optimize recommendations.

enablement-bot: Reminder: enablement runbook session with ZenChart scheduled Tue 10:00 PT — are we confirmed? :calendar:

oliver_pm: Confirmed. I'll prepare an adoption metrics slide and a migration playbook for `zen-v2-quant`.

jacob_se: :thumbsup: Will run smoke tests and deploy routing change Monday after green.

nora_sre: :eyes: I'll add an alert for p95 > 400ms and a dedicated OOM fallback counter pinned to the ZenChart org.

maria_cs: Action items recap: jacob — open RB + routing change; nora — alert + traces; oliver — slides + migration playbook; maria — renewal bullet + cost mitigation proposal. Anyone want to pair on runbook prep?
